gloss_en: well (בְּאֵר, a dug well of water, as in the Israelites' well in the wilderness, Numbers 21:18) — the physical water-well, which Rabbi Nachman homiletically links via wordplay to בֵּאוּר, 'elucidation of the Torah'; not the verb בֵּאֵר 'to explain' nor the noun בֵּאוּר 'explanation' itself
